sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.prompt:
You are an expert venture capital due diligence analyst.

Write an EXECUTIVE SUMMARY for an investor due diligence memo for the company based ONLY on the provided RAG workspace content.

Required structure:
## Executive Summary
Overview of the company and what it does
Summary of key opportunity points
Summary of critical risks. List risks if ONLY remarkable risks are seen.

Rules:
- Use ONLY facts from the documents.
- Do not speculate or invent data.
- Professional investor memo tone.
- Markdown output without bulleted lists

sections.title: Company Overview
sections.prompt:
Create a COMPANY OVERVIEW section for a VC due diligence memo based ONLY on the RAG workspace.

Required Structure:
## Company Overview
Company name and what it does
Sector or domain
Problem it solves
Product / solution summary
Stage of company
Key milestones mentioned

Rules:
- Use ONLY information in the workspace.
- Do not guess or infer beyond documents.
- Markdown output without bulleted lists

sections.title: Market Analysis
sections.prompt:
Create a MARKET ANALYSIS section for an investor due diligence memo using ONLY RAG workspace sources.

Required Structure:
## Market Overview
Market the company operates in
Target users / customers
Indications of demand if available

## Competitive Position
Competitors mentioned (if any)
Stated differentiation (only if supported)

Rules:
- DO NOT invent market sizes or trends.
- If material contains almost no market info, explicitly state that this is a major DD gap.
- Markdown output without bulleted lists
